routes.label: Calculate supplements or use their equality

question: \(\angle 1\) and \(\angle 2\) are supplementary, and \(\angle 3\) and \(\angle 2\) are supplementary. If \(\angle 1=40^\circ\), how many degrees is \(\angle 3\)?
solution: \(\angle 2=180^\circ-40^\circ=140^\circ\), and \(\angle 3=180^\circ-140^\circ=40^\circ\). Alternatively, since supplements of the same angle are equal, we can directly obtain \(\angle 3=\angle 1=40^\circ\).
